none: PAS WAW-8190A7: Roman Coin: nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Rally ID:55. Roman coin: A complete but worn, struck / hammered copper alloy nummus of probably of Constantine I (306 - 337 AD), of reverse type Mars in military dress, minted between 307 and 318 AD. Obverse: Head facing right. Obverse inscription: [ ] STIN [ ]. Reverse: Standing figure, probably Mars in military dress with spear and shield. Reverse inscription: illegible. Length: 16.52mm. Width: 14.7mm. Thickness: 2.09mm. Weight: 1.5 grams. Coin was photographed
